item.title: ADNOC Greenlights Abu Dhabi Upstream Gas Project
item.description: ADNOC announced a final investment decision to proceed with what it said is its first large-scale unconventional natural gas project.

item.title: US, Iran Study Proposals amid Limited Strikes
item.description: Iran and the U.S. are reviewing the latest proposals from mediators on how to bridge their divides and avert another round of all-out war, according to a diplomat briefed on the matter.

item.title: Kistos to acquire 30% stake in North Sea’s Abbey and Baker gas fields
item.description: Kistos signed a binding farmout agreement under which its wholly owned subsidiary, Kistos Energy, will acquire a 30% non-operated working interest in the Abbey and Baker gas developments in the UK Southern North Sea.

item.title: XRG to Buy Shell Stake in Australian LNG Project
item.description: Shell agreed to sell its 16.67 percent stake in the North West Shelf Project, which produces liquefied natural gas and domestic gas in Western Australia, to ADNOC's XRG.

item.title: San Mateo signs two natural gas deals in Northern Delaware Basin
item.description: Matador Resources announced that its subsidiaries within San Mateo Midstream signed two agreements in the Northern Delaware Basin, New Mexico.

item.title: Aramco Logs 9 Pct Higher Profit
item.description: Aramco posted a nine percent increase in third-quarter profit after a jump in earnings from its refineries and as the Iran war drove oil prices higher.

item.title: Blackstone-led group to invest $3.1bn in Mitsubishi’s LNG Canada stake
item.description: A Blackstone-led investor group has agreed to invest $3.1bn for a 49.9% stake in a subsidiary holding Mitsubishi's interest in the LNG Canada project.
